[[Starbreeze Village]] {{co|63|57|Teldrassil}} lies south of [[Shadowglen]] and east of [[Dolanaar]] in [[Teldrassil]]. Once a [[night elf]] [[village]], Starbreeze is now overrun by [[corrupted furbolg]]s, an indication of the demonic infection that bleeds into Teldrassil.
